clauses.name: Well-formed Claim
clauses.summary: Claim must be syntactically and structurally well-formed.
clauses.description: The system SHALL reject any claim that does not satisfy the canonical schema and basic structural invariants.
clauses.error_message: Claim is not well-formed under D-0.

clauses.name: Adjudicable Claim
clauses.summary: Claim must be admissible for adjudication.
clauses.description: The system SHALL only admit claims that satisfy admissibility constraints into adjudication.
clauses.error_message: Claim is not admissible for adjudication under D-1.

clauses.name: Rejection Grounds
clauses.summary: Claim fails one or more non-negotiable constraints.
clauses.description: The system SHALL reject claims that violate non-negotiable constraints.

clauses.name: Equilibrium Reached
clauses.summary: Adjudication has reached a stable, replay-safe equilibrium.
clauses.description: The system SHALL mark claims as equilibrium when all required constraints are satisfied and no further lawful transitions exist.
